detail.title: build(deps): bump actions/setup-node from 6.5.0 to 7.1.0
detail.body:
Bumps [actions/setup-node](https://github.com/actions/setup-node) from 6.5.0 to 7.1.0.
Release notes

Sourced from actions/setup-node's releases.

v7.1.0

What's Changed

Enhancements:

  • Add support for mise.toml file by @â€‹gperdomor in actions/setup-node#1421
  • Support absolute paths in node-version-file by @â€‹v-mahabaleshwars in actions/setup-node#1633

Bug fixes:

  • Add Node version validation and manifest fetch retry by @â€‹v-jitenderpalsingh in actions/setup-node#1580

Documentation updates:

  • README.md: bump actions/checkout to latest version 7 by @â€‹deining in actions/setup-node#1578
  • docs: add V7 ESM migration and NODE_AUTH_TOKEN behavior change by @â€‹v-gowridurgad in actions/setup-node#1593
  • Fixed cache recommendation syntax by @â€‹SubJunk in actions/setup-node#1603

Dependency updates:

  • Update workflow pins and migrate Node matrices to modern versions by @â€‹v-HarithaVattikuti in actions/setup-node#1583
  • Upgrade @â€‹actions/cache to 6.2.0 by @â€‹philip-gai in actions/setup-node#1584
  • Pin @â€‹types/node to v24 by @â€‹v-priyagupta108 in actions/setup-node#1585
  • Override brace-expansion to 5.0.8 by @â€‹v-priyagupta108 with @â€‹Copilot in actions/setup-node#1599
  • Upgrade actions/checkout from 7.0.0 to 7.0.1 by @â€‹dependabot in actions/setup-node#1598
  • Upgrade prettier from 3.8.4 to 3.9.6 by @â€‹dependabot in actions/setup-node#1590
  • Upgrade @â€‹vercel/ncc from 0.44.0 to 0.45.0 by @â€‹dependabot in actions/setup-node#1610
  • Upgrade pnpm/action-setup from 6.0.9 to 6.0.10 by @â€‹dependabot in actions/setup-node#1602
  • Upgrade baseline-browser-mapping from 2.10.38 to 2.11.22 by @â€‹dependabot in actions/setup-node#1629
  • Upgrade @â€‹types/semver from 7.7.1 to 7.8.0 by @â€‹dependabot in actions/setup-node#1616
  • Upgrade @â€‹typescript-eslint/parser from 8.62.0 to 8.70.0 by @â€‹dependabot in actions/setup-node#1615
  • Upgrade pnpm/action-setup from 6.0.10 to 6.1.0 by @â€‹dependabot in actions/setup-node#1631
  • Upgrade jest-each from 30.4.1 to 30.5.2 by @â€‹dependabot in actions/setup-node#1636
  • Upgrade eslint-plugin-n from 18.1.0 to 18.3.0 by @â€‹dependabot in actions/setup-node#1638
  • Update dependencies and add license files by @â€‹v-HarithaVattikuti in actions/setup-node#1642
  • Upgrade eslint from 10.5.0 to 10.11.0 and package.json from 7.0.0 to 7.1.0 by @â€‹dependabot in actions/setup-node#1635

New Contributors

  • @â€‹v-jitenderpalsingh made their first contribution in actions/setup-node#1580
  • @â€‹philip-gai made their first contribution in actions/setup-node#1584
  • @â€‹gperdomor made their first contribution in actions/setup-node#1421
  • @â€‹SubJunk made their first contribution in actions/setup-node#1603

Full Changelog: https://github.com/actions/setup-node/compare/v7.0.0...v7.1.0

v7.0.0

What's Changed

Enhancements:

  • Add cache-primary-key and cache-matched-key as outputs by @â€‹gowridurgad in actions/setup-node#1577
  • Migrate to ESM and upgrade dependencies by @â€‹gowridurgad in actions/setup-node#1574

... (truncated)

Commits
  • 949feb2 Bump eslint from 10.5.0 to 10.11.0 and package.json from 7.0.0 to 7.1.0 (#1635)
  • 7207c4f chore: update dependencies and add license files (#1642)
  • 54337e0 Bump eslint-plugin-n from 18.1.0 to 18.3.0 (#1638)
  • fb54fa8 Bump jest-each from 30.4.1 to 30.5.2 (#1636)
  • 7f84f1d Bump pnpm/action-setup from 6.0.10 to 6.1.0 (#1631)
  • 0c54c7b Bump @â€‹typescript-eslint/parser from 8.62.0 to 8.70.0 (#1615)
  • a829419 Bump @â€‹types/semver from 7.7.1 to 7.8.0 (#1616)
  • 680d1e4 Support absolute paths in node-version-file (#1633)
  • db0fb3a Bump baseline-browser-mapping from 2.10.38 to 2.11.22 (#1629)
  • 94196ee Bump pnpm/action-setup from 6.0.9 to 6.0.10 (#1602)
